usedFor: Rev AI holds analysis jobs and Microsoft Excel holds the table that “Add Row To Table” fills.

bestTemplate.name: “New Topic Extraction” in Rev AI, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every finished topic job adds a row, so results from many transcripts sit in one sheet.

watchOut: “New Topic Extraction” is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check, not when the job finishes.
